usage: nb-collab append [-h] [--markdown TEXT] [--code TEXT]
                        [--markdown-file PATH] [--code-file PATH]
                        [--summary TEXT] [--eta DURATION] [--execute | --wait]
                        [--follow] [--server-url SERVER_URL] [--token TOKEN]
                        [--settle SETTLE] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--poll POLL]
                        notebook

Appends markdown and/or code cells at the end of a JupyterLab-open notebook
via the YDoc/RTC channel. Inserted cells are tagged metadata.hera (a dict
carrying the version tag and an appended_at UTC timestamp) so they can be
filtered and timed later. Re-running with the same args double-inserts.

positional arguments:
  notebook              Path to .ipynb (absolute or relative to cwd).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --markdown TEXT       Append a markdown cell with this source. Pass '-' to
                        read the cell from stdin; multiple '-' flags consume
                        successive chunks separated by a line of '---|'.
                        Repeatable; order preserved across all
                        --markdown/--code variants.
  --code TEXT           Append an un-executed code cell with this source. Pass
                        '-' to read the cell from stdin (see --markdown for
                        chunk semantics). Repeatable; order preserved across
                        all --markdown/--code variants.
  --markdown-file PATH  Append a markdown cell whose source is read from PATH
                        (UTF-8). Repeatable; order-preserved.
  --code-file PATH      Append an un-executed code cell whose source is read
                        from PATH (UTF-8). Repeatable; order-preserved.
  --summary TEXT        One-line dense spec of the proposed measurement.
                        Rendered into the FIRST appended markdown cell, right
                        after its leading heading (or prepended if the cell
                        has none) as a timestamped blockquote: '> **14:32** ·
                        <summary>' — the clock is server-local time at append;
                        _/* in the text are escaped for rendering. Also
                        stamped verbatim to metadata.hera.summary on that
                        cell. Requires at least one markdown cell among the
                        appended cells (--markdown/--markdown-file); must not
                        contain a backtick. At most once.
  --eta DURATION        Expected runtime for the proposed measurement — '40m',
                        '2h', or '1h30m' (optional <N>h then optional <N>m, h
                        before m; at least one required, total > 0; fractional
                        values rejected). A bare number like '40' is REJECTED
                        — add the m/h suffix. Rendered into the FIRST appended
                        markdown cell's blockquote line (with --summary or
                        alone) as '**ETA ~15:12** (≈40 min)' in server-local
                        time, computed from the same append instant; crossing
                        local midnight adds ' (+1d)' right after the clock.
                        Also stamped as an ISO-8601 UTC instant to
                        metadata.hera.eta_at on that cell, and echoed to
                        stdout as 'eta: ~15:12 (≈40 min)'. Requires at least
                        one markdown cell among the appended cells. At most
                        once.
  --execute             After appending, run the last appended code cell
                        YOURSELF by the id this append just created (never
                        nb['cells'][-1] off the stale on-disk file). Policy-
                        gated like execute-cell (append_exec or edit_exec),
                        checked before any cell lands. Exit code reflects the
                        cell's status. Mutually exclusive with --wait.
=====
usage: nb-collab [-h]
                 {append,edit-cell,execute-cell,exec-all,delete-cell,wait,interrupt}
                 ...

nb-collab — drop cells into a JupyterLab-open notebook over the YDoc/RTC
channel.

positional arguments:
  {append,edit-cell,execute-cell,exec-all,delete-cell,wait,interrupt}
    append              Append cells to a live notebook (notebook must be
                        served by a running JupyterLab).
    edit-cell           Replace an existing cell's source (policy-gated;
                        requires edit_no_exec or edit_exec).
    execute-cell        Run an existing code cell against the notebook's
                        kernel (policy=append_exec or edit_exec).
    exec-all            Run every code cell in document order on one kernel
                        (policy=append_exec or edit_exec).
    delete-cell         Remove an existing cell by id (policy=edit_exec only).
    wait                Wait for a specific cell to finish executing.
    interrupt           Interrupt the notebook's kernel (the abort lever for
                        autonomous sweeps).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
=====
usage: hera-watch [-h] [--next] [--once] [--poll POLL] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                  [--follow] [--wait-start WAIT_START] [--channels CHANNELS]
                  [--raw] [--bias-current BIAS_CURRENT] [--every EVERY]
                  [--fs-warn FS_WARN] [--leak-excess-warn LEAK_EXCESS_WARN]
                  run_dir

Live run-dir digest: one line per landed sweep row (gain-divided Rxx/I stats +
progress/ETA) for an agent to tail.

positional arguments:
  run_dir               sweep run directory (contains metadata.json +
                        data.tsv). May not exist yet — the watch waits up to
                        --wait-start for it to appear. With --next, give a
                        data/ dir instead.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --next                treat run_dir as a data/ dir and latch onto the NEXT
                        run to appear (arm before the cell runs). Robust to
                        2nd+ runs and lowest-free-id allocation — snapshots
                        existing runs, waits for a new one.
  --once                digest current state then exit (no watch loop)
  --poll POLL           poll interval in seconds while watching (default 5)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     stop the measurement watch after this many seconds
                        (default 570, sub-CC-Bash-cap). See --follow.
  --follow              watch to completion with no deadline (multi-hour
                        runs); overrides --timeout. Use with a backgrounded
                        invocation.
  --wait-start WAIT_START
                        if run_dir doesn't exist yet, wait up to this many
                        seconds for it to appear (default 1800; <=0 waits
                        indefinitely)
  --channels CHANNELS   comma-separated lock-in channels to include (e.g.
                        sr1,sr2). Default: all.
  --raw                 report raw lock-in X (skip gain division). Escape
                        hatch.
  --bias-current BIAS_CURRENT
                        override I_bias in amps (default:
                        bias_voltage/bias_resistor from metadata)
  --every EVERY         1D sweeps: emit a digest line every N new rows
                        (default 25)
  --fs-warn FS_WARN     warn when a lock-in's max|X| reaches this fraction of
                        its full-scale sensitivity (default 0.90; SR830 rails
                        ~1.09×). Requires sensitivity in the instrument
                        snapshot.
  --leak-excess-warn LEAK_EXCESS_WARN
                        warn when a gate current's excess over its baseline
                        (max|I - I0|) reaches this many amps on 2+ consecutive
                        points (default 100e-12 = 100 pA)

# vti-02 — stacking-order campaign plan (ABAB / ABCA / ABCB)

*Rebuilt 2026-08-23 05:25 by the second HERA instance: the first instance's
`plan.md` was not on disk at handoff. Steps 0–3 are reconstructed from the
measure/ana notebooks and `data/`; steps 4+ are this instance's plan.*

## Goal → what discriminates the three stackings (transport, one Rxx pair)

| observable | ABAB (Bernal) | ABCA (rhombohedral) | ABCB (mixed) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B = 0 bands at D = 0 | two bilayer-like massive bands (light + heavy), semimetallic overlap | one flat-bottomed band (∝k⁴), CNP touching | Dirac-like + massive bands, small intrinsic gap |
| SdH at fixed n | **two** fundamentals, F₁ + F₂ = F_L(n) = nh/4e | **one** fundamental at F_L(n) (4-fold) until symmetry breaking | mixed: light Dirac tone + massive tone |
| R_CNP(D) at B = 0 | gap opens with D, modest (kΩ), saturating | gap opens strongly (≫ 10 kΩ, MΩ at 0.3 V/nm) | weak D dependence |
| Landau fan at D = 0 | two interpenetrating 4-fold LL ladders → **level crossings**, zero-LLs of both ladders (8+8) | **16-fold zero-energy LL** → first strong gaps at ν = ±8 (then ±12, ±16; ±4 only via symmetry breaking) | ν = ±2 (Dirac) among 4-fold steps |

The fan is decisive: the filling-factor sequence of the strong minima, the
presence/absence of LL crossings, and the zero-LL degeneracy are read directly.
The fan slopes (n = ν e B / h) also pin the absolute density scale, which so far
rests on the geometry prior for c_tg.

## Steps

0. **Bring-up / VERIFY** — done (measure [16]–[17], `VERIFY: ALL GREEN`; grant in `session_notes.md`).
1. **Gate C liveness + gate safety** (`gate-current-sanity-check`, runs 0–3) — done: alive on
   T_0→B_3 / B_1−B_2, Rxx 60–330 Ω, gate currents at the pA floor to every limit.
2. **0 T gatemap → CNP + (n, D) calibration** (`gatemap`, run 5; run 4 railed) — done (ana cell 13):
   ridge A slope → c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (prior 0.864); c_tg anchored at the 9.5 nm prior;
   n_offset −0.089e12; D_offset −0.013 V/nm from R_CNP(D) symmetry. R_CNP: 240 Ω (D≈0) → 2.4 kΩ
   at D ≈ +0.25 V/nm, saturating — a modest, saturating D-gap (leans ABAB/ABCB over ABCA, not decisive).
   Second, parallel, fainter ridge B: a second region 0.43e12 electron-doped vs A (series region).
3. **SdH spot checks at D = 0** (`sdh-spot-check`, runs 6 e-side n=+3.2e12 / 7 h-side n=−1.2e12) — done,
   analysed 05:20 (`hera_scratch/sdh_spots.py`, to land in ana): run 7 → 5.3 + 7.1 T fundamentals and
   their sum 12.4–12.6 T (= F_L); run 6 → 7.3 T and 29.4 T (sum 36.7 vs F_L 33.1 T, +11%). Two tones
   summing to F_L = two-band read → disfavours ABCA; the 11% is the c_tg scale to be fixed by the fan.
4. **Landau fan at D = 0** (`landau-fan`) — **NEXT** (operator's request). Fast axis: (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept
   along the calibrated D = 0 line, n = −1.275 … +3.25e12 in 0.025 steps (182 pts; hole side limited by
   TG −0.3 V). Slow: B 1.0 → 10.0 T in 0.2 T (46 rows), ascending from 0 T where the magnet sits.
   fast_delay 1 s (run-5 calibrated 1.17 s/pt), sr1 200 µV (20 kΩ FS: ν = 0 at 10 T may be insulating).
   ≈ 4 h 15 m; ends at 10 T with gates parked at 0. Establishes: ν of strong minima (4 / 8 / 12 …),
   crossings, zero-LL degeneracy, and dn/dB slopes → absolute n scale.
5. **Fan analysis** — re-form (fan_grids), log R map in (n, B) and (n, 1/B); trace minima; fit ν lines
   n = ν e B/h + n₀ → density-scale correction; compare the ν sequence against the table above.
   Land in ana with the running verdict.
6. **Conditional follow-ups (priced when reached, riding the magnet down from 10 T):**
   a. If the D = 0 fan is ambiguous between ABAB and ABCA (e.g. ν = ±4 and ±8 both strong):
      a D ≠ 0 fan (|D| ≈ 0.15–0.2 V/nm) — ABCA's 16-fold zero LL splits into layer-polarized
      octets (ν = ±8 stays, ν = 0 gap opens hard); ABAB shows the light/heavy ladders shifting.
   b. If the two-band picture holds: T-dependence of the two SdH amplitudes (LK masses) at one n —
      the light/heavy mass ratio is a stacking-model check (`set_both`, ratio 0.95, ≤ 20 K).
7. **Call** — final ana cell per the output contract (one region: B_1−B_2; the series region B is
   noted as a hedge, not a separately measured pair).
8. **Close-out** on the operator's `return-to-initial`.

## What would change my mind

- Fan shows a **single** 4-fold ladder with ν = ±8 as the first strong gap and no crossings → ABCA,
  and the spot-check "two tones" must be re-read as a split single band (spin/valley).
- Strong ν = ±2 minima (Dirac-like ladder) mixed with 4-fold steps → ABCB.
- Features that do not move with n (horizontal in the fan) → a parallel ungated region / contact
  artefact; the 7.1–7.3 T tone common to runs 6 and 7 is the thing to check for this.
- Region B (second ridge) contaminating the pair: a second, offset copy of every feature shifted by
  0.43e12 in n.
